speak: Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Date. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Amount 1B. Line 400 of the T2 return.
Amount 1C. Line 405 of the T2 return.
Amount 1D. Line 428 of the T2 return.
Amount 1E. Amount 1B, 1C or 1D, whichever is the least. Instance 1.
Amount 1F. Income eligible for the Nunavut lower tax rate. Amount 1E multiplied by the result of taxable income for Nunavut divided by taxable income for all provinces. Instance 1.
Amount 1G. Income subject to Nunavut higher tax rate. Amount 1A minus amount 1F. Instance 1.
Amount 2A. Nunavut tax at the lower rate. Amount 1F multiplied by 3%.
Amount 2B. Nunavut tax at the higher rate. Amount 1G multiplied by 12%.
Amount 2C. Nunavut tax before credits. Amount 2A plus amount 2B.
